name: AliasVault
description: AliasVault is a self-hosted password manager and email alias service for Runtipi.
short_desc: Self-hosted password manager with email aliases
author: AliasVault

form_fields.label: Public registration enabled
form_fields.hint: Allow anyone to create an account. Set to false to restrict access to invited or existing users only.

form_fields.label: Trusted proxies
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of trusted proxy IPs or CIDR ranges (e.g. 172.18.0.0/16,10.0.0.0/8). Required when AliasVault is behind another reverse proxy.

form_fields.label: Admin IP allowlist
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to access the admin interface (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24,203.0.113.10). Leave empty to disable IP restrictions.

form_fields.label: IP logging enabled
form_fields.hint: Enable logging of client IP addresses. Disable this for increased privacy if you do not need IPs in logs.
